g.text: This instruction is only applied to 1 unit of 0054 per machine located at Printing side
a) Apply double face tape all over the edges of cladding
b) Installed on the outer surface of 0054, Facing to the nearest short edge of 0541_Table_V2
c) Make sure to press along all the adhesive lines to the Structure leg
此说明仅适用于位于印刷侧的每台机器上的 1 个 0054 单元。
a) 在覆层边缘贴上双面胶带。
b) 将其安装在 0054 的外表面，朝向 0541_Table_V2 最近的短边。​​
c) 确保沿所有粘合线按压到结构腿上。
